item.title: S&P 500 futures fall to start shortened week as oil prices climb: Live updates
item.description: Wall Street is keeping tabs on the Middle East war and rising trade tensions between Canada and the U.S.

item.title: Bombardier points out U.S. footprint after Trump says aerospace giant must build in America
item.description: Trump's announcement comes on the eve of Canadian retaliatory tariffs set to take effect Tuesday on $20 billion of U.S. goods.

item.title: Qualcomm stock pops 10% on data center infrastructure deal with Amazon
item.description: Qualcomm is trying to move into the data center business, where Nvidia has been the dominant player in the AI boom.

item.title: AstraZeneca's COPD drug scores two late-stage trial wins as full data boosts blockbuster hopes
item.description: The full data reinforces hopes that the drug could be a breakthrough COPD treatment and reach AstraZeneca's peak annual sales forecast of more than $5 billion.

item.title: Here are Tuesday's biggest analyst calls: Nvidia, SpaceX, Apple, Intel, Airbnb, Lockheed Martin, Tesla & more
item.description: Here are Tuesday's biggest calls on Wall Street.

item.title: Here’s where rental demand is heading and what it means for future home sales
item.description: As U.S. rent prices rise, more tenants are relocating to cheaper markets, according to a new report by Zillow.

item.title: Brent crude oil near $98 after Iran's Houthi allies attack multiple Saudi energy facilities
item.description: Oil prices rose Tuesday on worries over escalating Mideast tensions after the U.S. and Iran traded strikes over the weekend.

item.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth $27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
item.description: Duties on U.S. steel and aluminum products have doubled to 50% as a war of words between Washington and Ottawa continues.

item.title: Visa tells CNBC it is expanding data offering for blockchain lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards surges
item.description: Visa is doubling down on blockchain-powered financial services with a new program to help issuers of stablecoin-linked cards access loans.

item.title: GE Aerospace to buy castings maker CPP for nearly $12 billion
item.description: GE Aerospace said on Tuesday it would buy castings supplier Consolidated Precision Products from Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners for $11.75 billion.

item.title: The U.S. is trying to reduce its reliance on China for batteries. Here's what it's up against
item.description: The Department of Energy has given grants to small battery tech companies. But the U.S. has a few years to do what took China decades.

item.title: Cholesterol drug setback casts doubt over multibillion-dollar race
item.description: Novartis’ failure raises the stakes for Amgen and Eli Lilly in the race to turn lower Lp(a) levels into fewer heart attacks and strokes.

item.title: Iran Foreign Ministry takes aim at Canada for support of U.S. actions in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Canada had condemned Iran’s "destabilizing actions" in the Middle East, saying that it would work with partners to maintain significant pressure on Iran.

item.title: EverBank to combine with WaFd in $3.9 billion reverse merger
item.description: EverBank has agreed to acquire WaFd, a smaller ⁠bank in the Pacific Northwest, in a $3.9 billion reverse ​merger transaction, ​the ​companies said on Monday.

item.title: Pharma major Novartis falls 9% after three drug trial setbacks
item.description: Shares of Novartis tanked on Tuesday after results from its del-desiran drug trial disappointed investors.

item.title: RBC says this fast casual stock down 50% from its highs is set to rise
item.description: The bank initiated coverage of Shake Shack with an outperform rating, with a belief that the stock is at an inflection point.

item.title: Australia to let social media users 'opt out' of algorithm-based feeds in fresh blow to big tech
item.description: Australia plans to give social media users the option to switch off algorithm-based feeds in proposed legislation, serving as the latest blow to tech giants.

item.title: TSMC, Samsung commit to ASML’s newest chipmaking tools as AI drives demand
item.description: TSMC and Samsung will adopt ASML’s High NA EUV tools for advanced chipmaking as AI drives demand for smaller, more complex semiconductors.

item.title: SpaceX rival launches rocket in historic first, says industry is 'desperate' for more
item.description: Isar Aerospace reached orbit on its second test flight as the German rocket startup looks to scale production amid booming satellite launch demand.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Tuesday
item.description: OpenAI's Astra model is generating a lot of buzz, and Intel shares are up almost 5% premarket.

item.title: Trump says he's made 'Hundreds of Billions of Dollars on Stocks' for the U.S., in stream of AI posts
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a stream of AI-generated images and a series of sweeping and unverified claims on Truth Social on Sunday

item.title: Bump-up CDs: What are they and which banks offer them?
item.description: While most CDs have an APY that's locked in for the term, a bump-up CD allows you to boost your rate before maturity.

item.title: SEC sues ISS as Trump administration ramps up scrutiny of proxy advisers
item.description: The SEC sued Institutional Shareholder Services to enforce a subpoena as the Trump administration increases scrutiny of influential proxy advisers.

item.title: SpaceX is a buy as the rocket company can solve one major bottleneck, says Pivotal Research
item.description: The research firm initiated coverage on the stock with a buy, believing that the company will find a way to reuse its Starship launch vehicles.

item.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over two years in major cost-saving drive
item.description: The luxury carmaker is targeting £1.7 billion ($2.3 billion) in savings as it faces Chinese competition, a cyberattack and U.S. tariffs.

item.title: Earnings upside for this defense giant isn't being appreciated by investors, says UBS
item.description: The bank upgraded Lockheed Martin to buy from neutral.

item.title: It's been a rough month of natural disasters. Here's a review of some of the worst
item.description: Natural disasters have intensified in the past month as the super El Nino phenomenon takes effect.

item.title: Crypto platforms have lost over $3.63 billion to cyberattacks — even though most of them did security checks

item.title: ‘Model fatigue’ sets in as AI labs race to roll out new versions at frenetic pace
item.description: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta and Google all released model updates this week, while Nvidia said it's acquiring open-source AI platform Hugging Face.

item.title: AI data centers are transforming rural land markets — and fueling a backlash
item.description: The data center buildout is driving up the price of rural land as some farmers and property owners buy in and others push back against development.
